thread:
anya: Quick heads-up — Large mid-market customer asked for a model: fixed monthly compute credits + optional shared compute pools as an add-on. Need alignment before roadmap review.
ben: Do we map this to reserved capacity or a new SKU? pinging @carlos for product/infra impact.
carlos: Prefer new add-on SKU 'compute-pool'. Reason: separate billing surface and different SLA. Pool = monthly quota + on-demand top-ups.
dana: Heads-up on infra risk: routing + billing integration + quota enforcement. If customers expect seamless failover between pools, that's nontrivial.
anya: Proposed launch checklist (draft): 1) Billing events + Console surface for pools, 2) Quota enforcement + routing fallback, 3) Contract clause + SLA for pool behavior, 4) Sales playbook + examples. Agree?
ben: Agree. Also need metering examples (how consumption maps to tokens/credits) and an FAQ for sales.
carlos: Implementation sketch: per-tenant token-bucket tied to pool SKU; pool allocation API; admin override for pilots; usage-refund edge cases. Rough timeline: 6 sprints for end-to-end.
dana: Prioritization ask: Can we scope a pilot in 3 sprints if we cut the Console UI (manual ops for pilot)? We want to validate demand before full UX.
pricing-bot: projection: Pilot with 2 accounts estimated +$28k ARR if uptake matches request (configurable). See growth model link: <internal-link>.
anya: Decision path: go-to-pilot if we can deliver: (A) billing events + CSV usage export, (B) manual admin override for two pilot customers, (C) contract addendum draft. I'll sync w/ legal & sales today. @ben please own pricing docs.
ben: On it — will spin up PR in pricing-playbook, add metering table and sample contract language.
carlos: One product note: don't bake model-level optimizations (quantization/compaction) into pilot scope. Keep pool delivery infra-only initially.
dana: :thumbsup: I'll create infra tickets and post ETA.
deploy-bot: created issue #4521 "compute-pool: token-bucket enforcement" and linked to epic EPIC-337.
anya: Thanks — small follow-ups: ben, please include sample invoice line items; carlos, draft the admin override API. We'll review Thurs.
ben: Will do.
carlos: Drafting now, will attach to the PR later today.
anya: Great. Closing loop — bring any red flags to the roadmap sync tomorrow. :eyes:
